Roles and Responsibility

  • Dean (Academics) and Professor

Professional body membership

  • ISTE, Life member.
  • Fellow of IEI

Achievements:

@ University Level

  • Presently serving as “Academic Senate Member, VTU” and “Chairman, BOS, Mechanical (Composite) Board, VTU” for the period of 2022-2025.
  • Currently serving as “Academic Council Member” as a representative of Hon’ble VC of VTU to BITM-Ballari for the period of 2021-2024 for autonomous system.
  • Served as Chairman, BOE, Mechanical (Composite) Board, VTU for the year 2021-22.
  • Served as “Academic Senate Member, VTU” from June 2019 to June 2022.
  • Serving/Served as Chairman, Local Inquiry Committee (LIC) of VTU.
  • Local Inquiry Committee (LIC) member of VTU.
  • Served as BOE member for Mechanical Engg. board of VTU for the year 2010-11
  • Served as BOS member in Mechanical board for Ph.D Registration Committee for Ph.D /M.Sc(Engg.) by research of VTU.
  • Served as ‘Chairman, BOE, Aeronautical Engg. (Composite) Board’, VTU during 2016-17.
  • Served as ‘Member, BOE, Mechanical Engg. (Composite) Board’, VTU for AY 2017-18.
  • Governing Council Member, VTU Nominee to Shashib Engg. College, Bangalore, for the period 2014-2016.
  • Governing Council Member, VTU Nominee to SJMIT, Chitradurga for the period 2017-2019.
  • Governing Council Member, VTU Nominee to VVIET, Mysore, for the period 2019-2021.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="FDP/Conferences/Workshops attended/Conducted" tab_id="1663402118406-5e4a1835-d982"][vc_column_text]

FDP/Conferences/Workshops attended/Conducted

  • FDPs/Workshops/Technical Talks have been conducting/organising to train the faculty on NBA and NAAC process.
  • Awareness programs are being conducted for the implementation of NEP in HEIs.
  • Attended more than 20 Workshop/Seminars.
  • FDP programs are also conducted especially for fresh teachers under “Teachers Induction Training Programs” to explore them on effective class room teaching.
  • “Faculty Enrichment Programes” have been conducted to assure the quality of teaching by the faculty members in the Teaching-Learning Processseveral guest lectures at various institutions.
  • Delivered lectures on “Turbo Machines” through Live Telecast of VTU-Edusatprogramme-15 during 2011.
  • Participated as Resource Person for “Carrier Counselling-2014” organized by The Hindu Education Plus on 31-5-2014 at Dr.TTIT, KGF.
  • Delivered motivational talk on “Towards excellence…..” for teachers at various Engineering colleges.
  • Invited talk on “Turbo Machines” at various colleges under FDP programs.
  • Training and motivating the faculty in making them excellent and confident in academic contents delivery under “Faculty Recharge Program”.
  • Regular conduction of FDP for the faculty to encourage them in updating the advances in their subject/specialization area.
  • As resource person to deliver talk in FDP on Turbomachinery and its Applications, during 26-27th August, 2016 at VVCE, Mysore.
  • As resource person for Faculty Enrichment Program on Teaching Techniques in Applied Thermodynamics, organized by VTU during July 2018 at VTU Centre for PG studies, Muddenahally, Chickballapur
  • An Overview of Teaching Techniques in Turbomachines, Faculty Enrichment Program jointly organized by AICTE and VTU during 22nd-26th July 2019 at VTU Centre for PG studies, Muddenahally, Chickballapur
  • Worked as Interview panel subject expert for various institutions.
  • Worked as Jury member in Project Exhibitions.
  • Session Chair- International Conference (ICOFTIME2020) at Presidency University Bangalore in virtual mode on 11th September and 12th September 2020.
  • Trained for NBA-Washington Accord Outcome based Accreditation process held at VTU-Mysore regional centre conducted by VTU, Belgaum and NBA, NewDelhi, during 2013-14.
  • Awareness program on Outcome Based Education NBA workshop held at BMSCE, Bangalore on 21-72015 in collaboration with VTU, Belgaum.
  • Examiner for Ph.D Comprehensive Viva/Thesis Evaluation/Final Viva-Voce
  • Journal Editorial/Reviewer: IJESM-VTU, JTEN

@ National Level

  • Executive Council Member for Indian Society for Technical Education (ISTE), New Delhi for the period 2020-2024.
  • UPSC Advisor Board member, New Delhi.

Research Area of Interest

  • Critical Heat Flux in Nuclear reactors,
  • Heat transfer enhancement in Free and Forced convection,
  • Heat and fluid flow problems,
  • FEM and CFD analysis,
  • Numerical analysis in enclosed cavities,
  • Non-Conventional energy utilization
  • Investigation on Eco-friendly refrigerators etc.
